name: Cream of Wheat Instant Original Hot Cereal
whyItWorks: Enriched with calcium carbonate and ferric orthophosphate (iron). The smooth, bland porridge is tolerated by even the most acutely inflamed guts during flare-up bowel rest.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Mix packet with 1/2 cup boiling water or lactose-free milk. Stir well.
